title: herdr-peers plan event (plan-event-v1)
description: The one JSON object `herdr-peers autopilot --loop --notify <command>` writes to that command's standard input when a watched plan needs the developer or finishes. One event per plan and situation; a plan that leaves a situation and returns to it is reported again. Never carries screen text, file content, prompt text or secrets.

event.description: stalled: three loop prompts without progress; blocked: the plan state records a blocker; no_lead: the lead is gone and no successor could be asked; completed: a plan the loop watched while open has finished. lead_moved: the pane the lead record names now works outside the plan's repository (a stale record); nobody is prompted. appointment_prompted: lead and every successor were gone for the appointment grace, the plan carries the grant and the daemon runs with --appoint, so its first live lane was asked to run `lead takeover --as-lane`; appointed: that lane now leads the plan. needs_human: the brain chose to tell the developer about a stalled or blocked plan or an agent waiting at an unknown screen (plan may be null). plan_queued_started: the next approved plan of a repository's queue was started by prompting its lead; queue_blocked: a queued plan cannot start for a reason the developer must fix (not approved, an amendment pending, no lead named, launch not available).

machine.description: `local` (the daemon's machine) or the saved-machine id where the plan lives.
